input.text: Crux is an agentic DSL for Rust. It provides macros, traits, and types that make agentic control flow explicit in the type system. Every step, delegation, speculation, and failure is a first-class value called Crux<T> that is inspectable, serializable, and replayable. The CruxCtx runtime provides step(), delegate(), speculate(), pipe(), join_all(), and route_on_confidence() primitives. The #[cruxx::agent] proc macro transforms an async function into an Agent trait implementation. TaskRegistry supports pluggable backends including InMemoryBackend and RedbBackend.
